voice.welcome: Welcome, Hygiene Hero! Pick a mission to beat the tiny troublemakers.
voice.suds-intro: Germ Tiny-Trouble is hiding on these hands. Let's use our soap shield!
voice.wet: First, get the hands wet. Tap the water drop.
voice.palms: Rub the palms together in bubbly circles.
voice.backs: Flip over. Scrub the backs of both hands.
voice.between: Slide the bubbles between every finger.
voice.nails: Scratch the fingertips on the palm to clean under the nails.
voice.rinse: Rinse the bubbles away. Bye-bye, tiny troublemakers!
voice.suds-cheer: Suds Shield complete! Clean hands help keep you ready for fun.
voice.smile-intro: Cavity Monsters love leftover food bits. Let's make this smile sparkle!
voice.paste: Use a pea-sized dot of fluoride toothpaste.
voice.fronts: Make gentle little circles on the fronts of the teeth.
voice.tops: Brush the chewing tops where snacks like to hide.
voice.insides: Sweep gently around the insides of the teeth.
voice.tongue: Give the tongue a gentle brush, too.
voice.floss: A grown-up can help floss the tiny spaces between teeth.
voice.two-by-two: In real life, brush for two full minutes, two times a day.
voice.smile-cheer: Smile Shield complete! The bright smile sent the Cavity Monsters packing!
voice.nudge: Follow the glowing spot. Your hero tool knows the way.
voice.keep-scrubbing: Super bubbles! Keep moving until all the bubble lights shine.
voice.keep-brushing: Sparkle power! Keep the brush moving in gentle circles.
voice.finale: Double hero power! Clean hands and a sparkling smile make a mighty team.
